results.idea: A: Direct Combination - EPS surprise + PSR + Momentum blend
results.description: Inspired by almost-alphas [0],[7],[14]. Weighted blend of EPS surprise quantile, psr percent quantile and long-run vol zscore; simple weighted add.

results.idea: A: Direct Combination - zscore momentum mix
results.description: Inspired by [10],[11],[27]. Blend reverse rank, vrv71 quantile and vrv71 ts_zscores with weights to diversify short/long momentum components.

results.idea: A: Direct Combination - Analyst + Model ratio
results.description: Inspired by [43],[65]. Average of EPS surprise and smartestimate quantiles, then divided by psr percent to add scaling from psr signal.

results.idea: A: Direct Combination - Financials avg + recent change
results.description: Inspired by [39],[38]. Combine cross-sectional average of two vec_avgs with recent delta of vec_avg(5idpqc) for hybrid level-change signal.

results.idea: A: Direct Combination - Volatility tempered returns
results.description: Inspired by [52],[79]. Ratio of short returns delta to volatility-scaled psr to favor returns with psr stability.

results.idea: A: Direct Combination - Momentum & analyst consensus
results.description: Inspired by [159],[63]. Combine long-run returns zscore with combined zscore of EPS surprise and psr_pct to capture momentum plus analyst view.

results.idea: A: Direct Combination - Normalize then group-scale
results.description: Inspired by [59],[95]. Normalize the average of two vec_avgs and then scale by winsorized version to stabilize group impact.

results.idea: A: Direct Combination - Decay momentum + analyst ratio
results.description: Inspired by [9],[71]. Use decay of returns zscore combined with EPS/smartestimate ratio for a blended momentum-forecast signal.

results.idea: B: Template A - Conservative group_rank of min(Model vs Momentum)
results.description: Inspired by ALPHA_IDEAS Template A and almost-alphas [24],[181],[214]. Min of ts_decay_linear rank of model minus utilization and ratio of ts_rank momentum over industry momentum, group_rank by industry then signed_power(0.8).

results.idea: B: Template B - Aggressive max of news delta * region momentum vs model ratio
results.description: Inspired by Template B, ALPHA_IDEAS news/momentum pattern and almost-alphas [41],[124]. Use ts_delta of mdl25_vrv421_91v as proxy for news-like shock times region momentum, versus model rank ratio; group_rank(subindustry) signed_power(0.5).

results.idea: B: Weighted Combination - group_scale conservative min
results.description: Inspired by Template C and almost-alphas [36],[31],[20]. Weighted add of vec_avg/eps surprise ranks vs ts_delta risk * industry momentum, group_scale(subindustry).

results.idea: B: Rank-over-risk ratio with group_rank
results.description: Inspired by almost-alphas [172],[174],[22]. Rank of vrv71 divided by (1+rank of vrv21) then group_rank by industry and signed_power to dampen extremes.

results.idea: B: Min of model avg and momentum delta scaled
results.description: Inspired by [39],[29],[12]. Min between avg of two vec_avgs rank and ts_delta of average model series multiplied by momentum rank; group_rank industry and signed_power(0.6).

results.idea: B: Decay linear of combined zscores group_rank
results.description: Inspired by [9],[14],[27]. ts_decay_linear of sum of ts_zscores of three vrv variants, then group_rank by subindustry and signed_power(0.5).

results.idea: B: Momentum vs Volatility ratio in group
results.description: Inspired by [52],[57],[158]. Ratio of short returns delta to its std dev, multiplied by indicator if mdl25_01v zscore positive; group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Weighted rank mix with ts_ir stability
results.description: Inspired by [31],[22],[131]. Add ts_ir of vrv81 to zscore of vrv71 with weights then group_rank by subindustry and signed_power(0.7).

results.idea: B: Conservative min of analyst-model average vs risk-adjusted delta
results.description: Inspired by [43],[48],[26]. Min between average quantile of EPS surprise and smartestimate and average deltas divided by risk; group_rank industry then signed_power(0.8).

results.idea: B: Aggressive max short-term price momentum vs model rank
results.description: Inspired by [211],[41],[42]. Max of short-term price momentum rank times region momentum and divide of model rank over price momentum; group_rank subindustry and signed_power(0.5).

results.idea: B: Weighted add of financial averages vs op_margin momentum
results.description: Inspired by [35],[36],[168]. Add weighted zscores of vec_avg financials and compare to ts_delta of op_margin; group_scale subindustry.

results.idea: B: Ratio of psr_pct to smartestimate with group_rank
results.description: Inspired by [70],[79],[81]. Quantile of psr_pct divided by smartestimate with small denom offset, then group_rank industry and signed_power(0.6).

results.idea: B: Min of price momentum and model delta with group_scale
results.description: Inspired by [28],[40],[159]. Min between combined deltas of model series and momentum condition; group_scale subindustry.

results.idea: B: Weighted rank of recent zscore & long-term zscore
results.description: Inspired by [32],[27],[134]. Combine short and long ts_zscore of vrv71 with weights, then group_rank industry and signed_power(0.6).

results.idea: B: Ratio with +1 denominator using ranked signals
results.description: Inspired by ALPHA_IDEAS ratio pattern and almost-alphas [50],[172]. Divide averaged returns zscore by (1+std rank) and group_rank subindustry for normalization.

results.idea: B: Signed power of group_ranked analyst-model composite

results.idea: B: Group-neutralized delta of financial averages

results.idea: B: Min of analyst ratio and momentum-weighted delta

results.idea: B: Weighted min between vec_avg rank and ts_av_diff momentum

results.idea: B: Momentum-adjusted analyst signal with winsorize

results.idea: B: ts_decay of combined ranks with group_rank
results.description: Inspired by [9],[129],[130]. ts_decay_linear of combined ts_rank signals from vrv81 and vrv91 then group_rank subindustry and signed_power(0.6).

results.idea: B: Ratio of model product to volatility with group_rank

results.idea: B: Combine ts_ir stability and zscore momentum
results.description: Inspired by [22],[158],[159]. Add ts_ir of mdl39 region rank and ts_zscore of returns, group_rank subindustry and signed_power(0.65).

results.idea: B: Max of recent improvement and analyst ratio

results.idea: B: Weighted add of short & long returns zscores with group_rank
results.description: Inspired by [33],[34],[32]. Combine vrv71 and vrv91 ts_zscores at short and medium windows, weighted and group_rank subindustry then signed_power(0.6).

results.idea: B: Group_scale of min(weighted model rank, price momentum)
results.description: Inspired by Alpha 3 pattern and almost-alphas [3],[3],[147]. Combine rank of model EPS surprise and ts_delta price momentum, then group_scale(subindustry).

results.idea: B: Momentum contrarian via news-like delta and volatility filter
results.description: Inspired by [40],[41],[42]. If short-term delta positive and long-run ir positive, favor signal scaled by low stddev condition; group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Combined quantile of financial averages with winsorize
results.description: Inspired by [62],[92],[93]. quantile of sum of vec_avgs with winsorized backfill to reduce outliers, then group_rank subindustry.

results.idea: B: Rank cross-section of ts_av_diff and backfill levels
results.description: Inspired by [103],[118],[190]. zscore of ts_av_diff combined with ts_backfill level rank, group_rank industry and signed_power(0.65).

results.idea: B: Differential zscore between returns and benchmark

results.idea: B: Smoothed analyst surprise momentum with decay
results.description: Inspired by [6],[82],[74]. quantile of ts_delta of EPS surprise over recent window combined with psr delta scaled by smartestimate; group_rank subindustry.

results.idea: B: Rank-weighted interplay of financial stddev and avg

results.idea: B: Composite zscore times industry momentum

results.idea: B: Ratio of quantile returns to stddev with signed power

results.idea: B: Heterogeneous time-scale zscore blend with group_scale

results.idea: B: Momentum-within-industry scaled by analyst surprise

results.idea: B: Stability-weighted model delta
results.description: Inspired by [26],[58],[152]. add inverse stddev of vrv21 and its delta to favor stable rising models, group_rank subindustry and signed_power(0.7).

results.idea: B: Max of backfilled financial avg and psr momentum
results.description: Inspired by [110],[38],[82]. max between ts_backfill average and difference between psr and recent EPS delta, group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Rank of returns adjusted by short-term price momentum bucket
results.description: Inspired by [211],[152],[129]. bucket rank of short-term price momentum and multiply by returns ts_zscore, group_rank subindustry.

results.idea: B: Combined winsorized zscore with analyst quantile
results.description: Inspired by [205],[63],[95]. winsorize and zscore backfilled financial avg added to analyst quantile, group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Ts_av_diff momentum amplified by model rank
results.description: Inspired by [105],[27],[177]. zscore of ts_av_diff of vec_avg amplified by quantile rank of mdl25_21v, group_scale subindustry.

results.idea: B: Dual timescale delta min with group_rank
results.description: Inspired by [29],[55],[56]. min of two delta signals across vec_avgs to be conservative, then multiply by sign of 01v zscore and group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Ratio of model rank over price momentum with group_scale
results.description: Inspired by [2],[50],[173]. rank(mdl)/ (1+rank(price momentum)) scaled within subindustry to remove cross-sectional biases.

results.idea: B: Signed_power of group_ranked combined zscores and returns

results.idea: B: Weighted conservative min using financial averages and psr change
results.description: Inspired by [35],[84],[96]. min between zscore of combined financial vec_avgs and difference of psr from its 252d mean, group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Momentum signal dampened by group_scale of volatility
results.description: Inspired by [180],[149],[150]. Multiply returns zscore by inverse of group stddev and group_scale by subindustry for stability.

results.idea: B: Composite quantile of model*eps surprise with group_rank
results.description: Inspired by [80],[94],[81]. quantile of product of smartestimate and EPS surprise, zscored then group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Decay-weighted delta of analyst psr combined with returns
results.description: Inspired by [9],[74],[87]. ts_decay_linear of add of psr percent delta and returns quantile, group_rank subindustry and signed_power(0.55).

results.idea: B: Rank of backfilled combined vec_avgs vs stddev contrast
results.description: Inspired by [113],[99],[181]. zscore of difference between vec_avg level and its stddev to favor stable high levels, group_rank industry.

results.idea: C: Clipped group_rank of EPS surprise zscore
results.description: Inspired by [5],[63]. Variation: winsorize and zscore of EPS surprise then clip to [-1,1], group_rank industry and signed_power(0.6) for stability.

results.idea: C: Signed power of group_ranked returns-differential clipped

results.idea: C: Group_scale of dampened financial delta

results.idea: C: Clipped ratio of model rank to volatility within industry
results.description: Inspired by [52],[26]. Variation: divide delta by stddev clipped to [-1,1] then group_rank industry and signed_power(0.65).

results.idea: C: Subindustry group_rank of clipped analyst composite
results.description: Inspired by [63],[68]. Variation: quantile of combined zscores of EPS and psr clipped to reduce extremeness, group_rank subindustry.

results.idea: C: signed_power of group_scale of winsorized financial avg

results.idea: B: Industry-neutralized momentum blend with group_rank

results.idea: B: Max of analyst-product and financial improvement
results.description: Inspired by [80],[38],[35]. max between product of smartestimate*EPS and recent improvement in vec_avg op_margin, group_rank subindustry.

results.description: Inspired by [132],[133],[95]. ts_target_tvr_hump on ts_backfill vec_avg then group_scale subindustry to achieve turnover target.

results.idea: B: Composite of ts_max_diff and returns for rapid movers
results.description: Inspired by [157],[160],[87]. ts_zscore of ts_max_diff combined with returns ts_zscore, group_rank industry and signed_power(0.6).

results.idea: B: Rank-weighted min between psr quantile and model stability
results.description: Inspired by [79],[124],[125]. min between psr quantile and ts_quantile of mdl25_21v to prefer psr when model less extreme; group_rank subindustry.

results.idea: B: Momentum cross-product scaled by analyst surprise
results.description: Inspired by [178],[80]. Multiply quantile of vrv91 by ts_zscore of mdl25_21v and scale by EPS surprise quantile; group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Weighted add of backfilled financial pairs and delta
results.description: Inspired by [111],[116],[30]. Weighted normalization of combined vec_avgs plus a delta term to capture level and change, group_scale subindustry.

results.idea: B: Ratio of zscore returns to group volatility with signed_power
results.description: Inspired by [53],[149],[180]. Divide ts_zscore of returns by group_std_dev and apply signed_power for dampening, group_rank industry.

results.idea: B: Max of analyst momentum and model-derived delta
results.description: Inspired by [77],[85],[28]. max between quantile of min(psr estimates) and long delta of psr_pct, group_rank subindustry signed_power(0.5).

results.idea: B: Industry zscore momentum combined with model rank
results.description: Inspired by [208],[211],[21]. ts_zscore of industry momentum rank combined with rank of mdl39 price component, group_rank industry.
